name: transparent
description: Leave the background transparent, to lay the scene over other clips.

name: background
description: The colour behind the scene when it is not transparent.

name: tone_mapping
description: How bright light is fitted into the picture: aces is filmic and punchy, agx keeps highlights' colours, neutral changes colours least.

fields.name: strength
fields.description: How strong the glow is; 0 turns it off.

fields.name: threshold
fields.description: Linear brightness above which parts glow.

name: depth_of_field
description: Blur in front of and behind the subject the scene keeps in focus.

fields.name: aperture
fields.description: Blur strength away from the focus: at 1, things twice as far as the focus get the largest blur; 0 turns it off.

fields.name: max_blur
fields.description: The largest blur radius, as a fraction of the frame height.

name: motion_blur
description: Motion blur from sub-frames spread over the shutter interval and averaged.

fields.name: samples
fields.description: Sub-frames per frame; 1 turns motion blur off, and render time grows with the count.

fields.name: shutter
fields.description: The fraction of a frame the shutter is open: 0.5 is a 180 degree shutter.

name: width
description: Canvas width in pixels; the template's own when omitted.

name: height
description: Canvas height in pixels; the template's own when omitted.

name: duration
description: Length in seconds; the template's own when omitted.

name: fps
description: Frames per second; the template's own when omitted.
